     * OkHttp internal classes.

methods.name: public static CacheHolder create(@NonNull File directory, long maxSizeBytes)
methods.comment:
* Returns a new {@link CacheHolder} containing an OKHttp Cache with the specified settings.
         *
         * @param directory a writable directory
         * @param maxSizeBytes the maximum number of bytes this cache should use to store

         * @hide

methods.name: public boolean isEquivalent(@NonNull File directory, long maxSizeBytes)
methods.comment:
